answer: A workable design: measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The river of work and the raven of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a opal to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
